site.name: 2026 Elections
meta.description: Official first-round results of Brazil's 2026 elections, from the whole country down to each polling station, with TSE's data.

brazil.title: 2026 first-round results
brazil.intro: Official TSE results for the first round, held on October 4, 2026.
brazil.statesNote: These races are decided per state. Choose a state to see its results.
area.intro: Official TSE results in this state, by race. Each race has a page with every candidate.
area.abroadIntro: Votes of voters who live outside Brazil. Abroad, only the presidential race is held.
race.twoChoices: Each voter chose two candidates, for {seats} seats. Shares are of all valid votes in the race.
race.proportionalSeats: {seats} seats, filled by proportional representation. Valid votes include the votes cast for a party's list.
results.underAppealNote: Votes for candidacies or party lists with an appeal pending. TSE annuls them until a decision and does not count them as valid.
results.partiesNote: Each party's total adds its candidates' valid votes and the votes cast for its list.
results.partySum: Candidate votes ({candidates}) + list votes ({list}) = {valid} valid votes.
totals.title: Totals
footer.credit: Source: Brazil's Superior Electoral Court (TSE), Open Data Portal. Processing: Brazilian Election Analysis (github.com/luizcartolano2/brazilian-election-analysis).
footer.author: Made by Luiz Cartolano
sources.title: Sources
sources.intro: Every number on this site comes from the public files of Brazil's Superior Electoral Court (TSE): its Open Data Portal and its results site.
sources.checks: Before publishing, the processing checks every number against TSE's own totals, per polling station, per municipality and zone, per state and for Brazil. If one number does not match, nothing is published.
sources.fixtures: This is a test build, made from a sample of TSE's files.
